listNote: 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze. 28 hidden on PlayStation, 0 online. Names, descriptions and grades follow the official list as Exophase and PSNProfiles publish it; every guide below is written for this codex in its own words.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum lands the moment the other 54 are yours - there is no extra task hiding behind it. PowerPyx puts the whole run at roughly 200 hours and rates it 4 out of 10, so treat this as a marathon checklist, not a skill wall. No online play or DLC is needed; every trophy is single-player and offline.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Pure story: finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission of Chapter 1, and this pops on its own. Nothing to prepare and nothing to miss - just play the introduction through. PowerPyx lists it as automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 in full. The trophy follows the chapter's closing mission, so keep pushing the main story and it arrives by itself. One warning for later: the Chapter 1 meditation for Positive Mental Attitude happens here, so do not rush past it.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Same deal as the other chapter trophies: story only, no side requirement, no way to miss it. By the end of this chapter Jason and Lucia are playable together, which opens the last meditation spot.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Keep the story moving; the trophy is tied to the chapter's closing mission, and the back half of the game opens up after it.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. One chapter left after this one, so you are nearly through the story half of the list. Bank vault jobs open through an optional mission in this chapter - take it when it appears.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission and the gold is yours. Once the credits roll, free-roam opens and the 100% checklist becomes visible under Progress, then Stats - so this trophy is the doorway to the long second half of the hunt.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the Breakfast Run mission. Story only - play the mission when it comes up in the chapter flow and the trophy follows. No prep, no detour.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist. Another mission trophy: show up, finish the job, move on. Heist practice here pays off later, when the vault and gang-operation robberies start counting toward 100%.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the Child's Play mission. Story only, no prep needed - the trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the Headliners mission. Just play it when the story hands it to you; there is nothing to set up in advance.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the VCIA Takedown mission. Story only. The airport comes back later for Catch Me If You Can, so learn the layout while you are here.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory. The last of the named-mission trophies - finish the mission and it pops.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist, which appears under Progress, then Stats, after the story. PowerPyx calls this the hardest trophy and the platinum's biggest time sink - about 100 of the roughly 200 hours. The good news: the checklist is lenient, closer to 60% true completion, and only robberies, underwater finds, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests demand everything.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts of any kind - stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps all count. PowerPyx counts 397 stunt spots across Leonida, and the 100% checklist wants 300, so keep chaining them after this trophy pops. Check the map under Touch Pad, Exploration, Stunt Spots, and your total under Progress, Activities, Stunts.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.desc: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool and basketball are the ones PowerPyx names, with three more to discover. You only need one go at each, so sample everything early and tick this off cheaply.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.desc: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Ranges open as you explore; take each challenge slow and steady, since gold rewards clean accuracy over rushing, and every range stays open after the story. This is also one of the few things the 100% checklist demands in full.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.desc: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. Learn each course's tight corners before pushing for the win, and mop up any locations you skipped once free-roam opens. All 14 are required for 100% too.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races - different events, not the same one twenty times. Mix race types as you travel so the count climbs while you do other things, and keep an eye on the race list so you do not repeat one you already won.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.desc: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing opens early, so take the challenge when it appears; fish patiently and match Cal's pace rather than rushing your casts, and the trophy follows the win.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game - any machine, any game, start to finish. Arcades are scattered around Vice City, so this is a quick stop between missions and a good first taste of the activities list.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's final mission. Andy's strand is Lucia-only, so play her missions when they appear - a questline tied to one character cannot be done as the other. Everything is still available after the story, so finish the strand in free-roam if you missed it mid-story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission. Follow Kenton's strand to its last job; the trophy pops when that mission ends. Kenton's treasure sets tie into the 100% checklist too, so keep an eye out for them along the way.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final mission. Play Billy's strand through to its conclusion - the trophy is the strand's endpoint, not a side objective inside a mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.desc: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. PowerPyx notes it is still confirming exactly which strands count, so work through every stranger you meet rather than stopping at exactly eight. Every quest giver tied to a trophy returns after the story, so this is safe to finish in cleanup.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final mission. See Randy's strand through to its last job and the trophy pops at the end of it.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final mission. Tyrone's strand is Jason-only, so play it as Jason when it opens - swapping characters is the only way to reach it.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.desc: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida's 10 meditation locations - the list's only possibly missable trophy. Do NOT skip the first one: after the Down to Earth mission in Chapter 1, Lucia invites Jason to meditate on the balcony of his house, and that spot is gone once Chapter 1 ends. The last spot needs Jason and Lucia playable together, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Track spots at Touch Pad, Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. The 100% checklist only asks for 15 of 18, so a missed Chapter 1 spot cannot cost you A Long Road - but do it anyway.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.desc: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's quests are Jason-only; take the hunt when it appears and follow the tracking prompts to the animal. Bret's quests are also one of the few things the 100% checklist demands in full, so do not leave them.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets out of 18. Cards hide across all five counties; the 100% checklist wants 15 full sets, so keep collecting past this trophy - three sets is just the warm-up.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations - landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher tags all count. Scan everything unfamiliar as you pass it; there are 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures in the game, so 100 scans is well within reach if you keep the app open while travelling.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the game's 80 challenges, spread across eight groups of ten. The 100% checklist wants 70, so this trophy is the halfway mark - pick the easy groups first and skip the hardest ten entirely.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.desc: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. Build the wanted level with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and lay low until the stars clear - a quiet stretch of countryside beats a highway chase.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.desc: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Plan a short route between three shops, hit them in quick succession, and keep the getaway vehicle close so the wanted level never drops between robberies.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. The WAiNK app flags new models as you pass them; hotel driveways around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are the best hunting ground, per GTABase. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models scanned, so keep the app open.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.desc: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus only when a group is clustered, then work through five targets before it ends - a tight room beats an open street for this one.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.desc: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA - the airport. No ticket, no schedule: get a vehicle moving fast and leave the airport grounds by an unofficial route. The trophy pops the moment your exit registers.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos - get up close with the tanks. Find a Rhino out in the world, then deal with it on foot or from a vehicle; expect heavy resistance and keep an escape route ready before you poke it.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.desc: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: no alarms, no witnesses spotting you. Plan the entry, move slowly, grab the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vault jobs open through an optional mission in Chapter 4, and there are 8 vaults in total - the 100% checklist wants all 8, so rob more than the five this trophy needs.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.desc: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush a truck on a quiet road, crack it open, grab the cash and lose the heat before the trophy counts - the escape matters as much as the robbery.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map fills in as you travel; sweep the corners you never had reason to visit - the far keys, the swamps and the northern counties - and the last area pops the trophy.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.desc: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. One operation per gang, nine total; the 100% checklist also wants all 39 gang operations, so these nine are the start of a much longer robbery list.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.desc: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Find a bar seat with the ocean in front of you, order a cocktail, and let the scene play - a small breather trophy between missions.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.desc: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive through the showroom glass and keep going - the trophy wants the dramatic exit, not a careful one.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.desc: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Play a frame at that alley - the trophy is about showing up at the named spot, not about your score.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED - the method for this trophy is not yet pinned down by any guide we could verify, and this codex will not guess. The description hints at a partnership moment with mass appeal; check PowerPyx's guide for updates as players confirm it, and do not chase rumored methods.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse - PSN tracks a count toward 500. Keep playing and choosing; the count climbs across story decisions and side choices alike, so this fills in naturally over a full playthrough.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED - no verified method yet. The description suggests succeeding on a second try at something, but no guide has confirmed what, and this codex will not invent a method. Watch PowerPyx and PSNProfiles as the community confirms it.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED - no verified method yet. The description suggests witnessing something strange out in Leonida, but no guide has confirmed the trigger, and this codex will not guess at one. Check PowerPyx's guide once players pin it down.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.desc: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Line up a pedestrian from a moving vehicle and land the melee hit as you pass - the trophy is the drive-by, not the bowling alley.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.desc: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies; feed them through your laundering contacts steadily and the total climbs - big heists move the number fastest.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy weapons, clothes, cars and upgrades as you play; the total is cumulative across every shop, so normal spending across a full playthrough gets most of the way there.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages unlock as you progress and earn; buy each one when it appears - they also give you somewhere to keep the vehicles Whip It Good wants you to find.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.desc: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Any ten vehicles you own or find - open the app, register them, and repeat until the count hits ten.
